page: Microsoft Azure NG32adms_V620_v1 is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine built on Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization. The instance features 32 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs powered by AMD processors, accompanied by 176.0 GB of system memory, delivering a ratio of 5.5 GB of RAM per vCPU. Compute acceleration is supplied by a single dedicated AMD V620 graphics processor providing 32 GB of VRAM.

Storage architecture includes a bundled 4,940 GB local NVMe SSD, providing extensive high-throughput capacity for ephemeral storage, caching, and staging large assets. The instance is also compatible with Azure Premium Storage for persistent managed disks. Outbound and inbound network access requires custom IP configuration, as zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are allocated by default.

With its combination of an AMD V620 accelerator, substantial memory allocation, and high-capacity local solid-state storage, the NG32adms_V620_v1 is engineered for graphics virtualization, visual rendering pipelines, cloud gaming hosts, and GPU-driven analytical workloads that require large local datasets.
description: Microsoft Azure NG32adms_V620_v1 is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine designed for graphics-intensive and memory-demanding workloads. Operating on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, the platform delivers 32 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs powered by an AMD processor and 176.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 5.5 GB per-vCPU density. Dedicated visual and parallel computing capabilities are enabled by an AMD V620 GPU equipped with 32 GB of VRAM. For high-speed data access, the instance includes 4,940 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and maintains support for Premium Storage tiers. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included. The hardware profile makes this instance suited for remote workstations, 3D visualization, cloud gaming infrastructures, video encoding pipelines, and GPU-accelerated processing tasks that depend on low-latency local storage.
